arguments.command:
cd /app/work && python3 - <<'EOF'
import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'/app/work')
from h import *

# 1. idle timeout disabled (idle_ms=0) -> stays open
t = trace('a', [dg(0,[pkt('I',0,[F(type='PING')])])], idle_ms=0)
print('T1', run({'version':1,'traces':[t]})['results'][0]['connection'])

# 2. idle: last_activity 0, idle_ms=10, tick at 25 -> terminate at 10
t = trace('a', [tick(25)])
print('T2', run({'version':1,'traces':[t]})['results'][0]['connection'])

# 3. activity at t=3 then tick at 100, idle 10 -> terminate at 13
t = trace('a', [dg(3,[pkt('I',0,[F(type='PING')])]), tick(100)], idle_ms=10)
r=run({'version':1,'traces':[t]})['results'][0]
print('T3', r['connection'], r['packets'])

# 4. LAYOUT: A packet not final
t = trace('a', [dg(0,[pkt('A',0,[F(type='PING')]), pkt('I',0,[F(type='PING')])])], idle_ms=0)
print('T4', run({'version':1,'traces':[t]})['results'][0]['packets'])

# 5. LAYOUT with A last -> ok
t = trace('a', [dg(0,[pkt('I',0,[F(type='PING')]), pkt('A',0,[F(type='PING')])])], idle_ms=0)
print('T5', run({'version':1,'traces':[t]})['results'][0]['packets'])

# 6. INITIAL_TOO_SMALL
t = trace('a', [dg(0,[pkt('I',0,[F(type='PING')])], size=1199)], idle_ms=0)
print('T6', run({'version':1,'traces':[t]})['results'][0]['packets'])

# 7. EARLY_REJECTED + early=true accepted, Z/A share pn space
t = trace('a', [dg(0,[pkt('Z',5,[F(type='PING')]), pkt('A',5,[F(type='PING')])])], early=True, idle_ms=0)
print('T7', run({'version':1,'traces':[t]})['results'][0]['packets'])

# 8. buffering: A absent, buffer_packets=1
t = trace('a', [dg(1,[pkt('A',0,[F(type='PING')]), pkt('A',1,[F(type='PING')])]),
                key(2,'A','install'), dg(3,[pkt('A',2,[F(type='PING')])]), key(4,'A','discard')],
          idle_ms=0, buffer_packets=1)
print('T8', run({'version':1,'traces':[t]})['results'][0]['packets'])

# 9. buffered at EOF
t = trace('a', [dg(1,[pkt('H',0,[F(type='PING')])])], idle_ms=0)
print('T9', run({'version':1,'traces':[t]})['results'][0]['packets'])

# 10. KEYS_DISCARDED for pending
t = trace('a', [dg(1,[pkt('H',0,[F(type='PING')])]), key(2,'H','discard')], idle_ms=0)
print('T10', run({'version':1,'traces':[t]})['results'][0]['packets'])
EOF
